test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The shops at the Indian airports have to ______ prices in Indian rupees.
solution:
The correct answer is **'display.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Display** means to put something in a place where people will see it or where it will attract attention.

 ​ ** -Example: **Her trophies are in a display case.

So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is **'Display'.**

The complete sentence is **"The shops at the Indian airports have to display__ prices in Indian rupees..".**​

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Convert** means to change from one form, system or use to another.
 
• **Trace** means a mark, an object or a sign that shows that somebody/something existed or happened.
 
• **Tag** means a small piece of card, material, etc. fastened to something to give information about it; a label.
